title: This is an "ok" office chair
text: This is an "ok" office chair. This chair is ok.  It had a few mishaps on the assembly, but it worked out.  It would be nice if they chair had arms to add to the comfort.  It's not as comfortable as I thought it would be, but it serves the purpose of a rolling chair.

product_metadata.title: EdgeMod Risa Task Chair in Vegan Leather, Grey
features: QUALITY MATERIALS - Thanks to the quality-tested pneumatic gas lift you’ll have adjustable height and a 360º range of movement. A chromed steel base and castors make the Risa Task Chair sturdy, and the soft ribbed vegan leather material will look gorgeous and last!

SIMPLICITY IN DESIGN - Make a statement with an adjustable armless chair that completes your workspace. Featuring striking modern design, this version shows off a bold and sophisticated presence. The Risa Task Chair is the no-nonsense piece that complements any space where work is done.

FREEDOM OF MOVEMENT - Built for a variety of tasks, the Risa Task Chair is armless to free up a full range of motion for you to move about your workspace. With simple and compact construction, the Risa is just what your working area needs to get the job done!

WARRANTY GUARANTEE - At Poly&Bark quality is our gold standard. We want furniture that lasts. We work with crafters that we know and trust - crafters who offer the level of quality we know our customers desire and deserve. While we don’t limit ourselves to plastics and wood, we do insist on fabulous materials and high-end craftsmanship. Every product we sell comes with a 1-year guaranteed warranty.

CHAIR MEASUREMENTS - Overall Product Dimensions: 21"W x 21"D x 32"-38.5"H. Seat Dimensions: 16"W x 17"D x 16.5"-23"H, Backrest Dimensions: 16"W x 15"H, Base Dimensions: 21"W x 21"L, Weight Limit: 250 lbs.
description: Add style, comfort, and efficiency to your work or home office with the Risa Task Chair. The rippling vegan leather seat gives you chic durability, while the waterfall seat design is pleasant to sit in all day. Easy to roll wheels, no arms and a 360 degree swivel make it easy to check off all the tasks on your list, giving you more time to spend doing the things you love. If simplicity and effeciency is your style, the Risa Task Chair is the everything you're looking for.
